cohort: 143 women with postnatal and post-aborted infections identified as near miss or death at a tertiary care hospital.
finding: Cesarean section and septic abortion were significantly associated with postnatal infection leading to maternal near miss or mortality.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was significantly associated with maternal near miss and mortality (p<0.01), with 58.1% of near miss cases and 71.4% of maternal deaths having cesarean section as the initial procedure.
